_about: Icon inventory added by change request CR-01 (spec revision 4: deleting a finished analysis from the phone, shared progress). Same rules and schema as ../icons.json (Lucide v1.51.0, ISC, Feather-derived glyphs MIT; 24 x 24 grid, round caps and joins). Staged apart from the v1 export so the 173-file inventory WP-03 converts stays exactly as frozen (design.md 6.1). Export: tools/lucide_icons.py --inventory cr01/icons.json --svg-dir cr01/svg/icons, then tools/svg2vd.py per master into cr01/export/res/drawable/ (precision 3, as export_vectors.py does for icons). Conversion into :core:designsystem (PhonoIcons, bundled.json, notices 7.3) is the integrator WP-26's, in CR-01-A2 (work-plan 4.7). 'reuses' lists the existing v1 resources CR-01 gives new uses; they need no new file.
